karpo_decision_31b.author: MachinePulse AI

cost.basis: GPU-time estimate from v1.8.0: one monthly-rented RTX PRO 6000 96 GB, USD 1.5235/hour; average load 70%. Architecture: dense gemma, 31B active parameters; throughput 10106.516129 tokens/s (architecture-class calibration, efficient-engine prefill). GPU-time cost USD 0.0252347746738464/1,000; old list-price estimate USD 0.0379665815983882/1,000 (google/gemma-4-31b-it at USD 0.09/M input and USD 0.34/M output). Applied min(old list-price estimate, GPU-time cost) = USD 0.0252347746738464/1,000. Estimated, not a bill.

karpo_decision_31b.disclosure: Paid evaluation, published with the author's consent. Measured by us on an evaluator-owned rented GPU with the author's own serving code at the pinned commit, offline (no network) during the sealed run. As agreed for this evaluation, this row shows the standard scores only; the per-category breakdowns are not published. Failed or unanswered requests count as wrong answers.
karpo_decision_31b.endpoint_condition: Evaluator-owned Verda GPU VM (RTX PRO 6000), offline read-only container (--network none); author's karpo_decision.serve.server unchanged at code commit 25c38826 (github.com/machinepulse-ai/karpo-decision), bf16 backbone + fp32 readout, one forward pass, no generation.
